jobs.how: Turn scheduling on once, set every on-board schedule slot (AV 46-87) to 1440, then command occupancy with DDC Occupied Override. An occupied input always wins, so any slot not at 1440 keeps the unit occupied.

points.use: Write on (1) once; not an occupancy command
Write 1440 (no schedule); same for every slot to AV 87
Write 1440; last schedule slot (Saturday C end)
Write: occupied/unoccupied command from the BMS

jobs.how: Activate Based On and the Tempering Mode AVs decide which setpoints the unit uses, separately for occupied and unoccupied. Setpoints that don't match the chosen mode have no effect.

points.use: Write unoccupied heat tempering mode, same values
Write unoccupied cool tempering mode, same values

jobs.how: Write the occupied and unoccupied setpoints for the mode you chose: space, intake or discharge. Discharge setpoints need the tempering mode set to discharge.
Trend the main air temperatures, humidity, static pressure, CO2 and airflow. Temperatures follow the unit's F/C setting and the guide lists no engineering units.
Read blower VFD data, gas valve and economizer status and compressor values. The gas valve output reads 10 V at high fire and also when the unit is not heating, so check the gas valve status too.

points.use: Read: main gas valve stage 1, 1 = ON
Read: main gas valve stage 2, 1 = ON
Read: modulating gas valve 1 output, 0 V = low fire

jobs.job: Direct DDC and virtual thermostat calls
jobs.how: The DDC heat, cool and blower commands only act when the tempering modes are DDC (3). The virtual stat calls only act when Activate Based On is Stat (4).

points.use: Write: heat command; needs tempering mode = DDC (3)
Write: cool command; needs tempering mode = DDC (3)
Write: blower command; heat and cool modes = DDC
Write heat modulation 0-10 V: 0 = low fire, 10 = high
Write 1 = On: call for blower (Activate On Stat)
Write 1 = On: call for heat (Activate On Stat)
Write 1 = On: call for cool (Activate On Stat)
Write 1 = On: call for dehumidification (Activate On Stat)

jobs.job: Sensor values the BMS can supply
jobs.how: Enable the external space temperature or humidity first, then write the BMS value with one decimal.

points.use: Write 1 = Enable to use a BMS space temperature
Write 1 = Enable to use a BMS space humidity
Write: BMS space relative humidity, 1 decimal
Write 1 = ON to use return temp as space

jobs.how: Six AIs each hold an active fault code; decode them with the fault code table in CaptiveAire's DDC guide.

checklist: Check whether the Protocessor was factory set for BACnet IP or MS/TP, because the objects are only reachable on that port.
Set a unique device instance (default 50001) and, on MS/TP, a unique MAC (default 51, 38400 baud, Max Master 127), or change the default IP 192.168.1.24 in the web configurator.
Give each changed gateway parameter its own Submit and then restart the system.
Verify reads of AI 139 (UnitStatus), AI 140 (CurrentOccupiedStatus), AI 141 (AverageSpaceTemp), AI 148 (DischargeTemp) and AI 210 (ActiveFault1).
Write BV 216 (SchedulingEnabledFlag) on once and set every schedule AV from AV 46 (ScheduleSundayAStart) to AV 87 (ScheduleSaturdayCEnd) to 1440.
Command BV 5 (DDCOccupiedOverride) occupied and then unoccupied, confirming AI 140 (CurrentOccupiedStatus) follows each time.
Confirm the tempering modes AV 217-220 and Activate Based On AV 221/222, then write a matching setpoint such as AV 18 (SpaceCoolOccSP) and watch AI 139 (UnitStatus).
If writes to user or factory settings are refused, check the HMI settings BMS User Write and BMS Factory Write, which default to Disabled.
Map AI 210-215 (ActiveFault1-6) as alarms and decode them with the guide's fault code table.
